newsitem.title: USA: NY subway gunman appeals civil trial judgment.
newsitem.headline: NY subway gunman appeals civil trial judgment.

text.p: Subway gunman Bernhard Goetz believes he should not have been put on trial and has appealed all judgments in the $43 million civil lawsuit he lost to one of the teenagers he shot, his attorney said Wednesday.
Goetz argued in the appeal that shooting victim Darrell Cabey "perpetrated a fraud against the court by fabricating his neurological condition" following the 1984 "subway vigilante" shootings.

Goetz, who said he was being mugged by four teenagers when he opened fire in a New York subway car, filed papers Wednesday asking the Appellate Division of the New York Supreme Court to reverse rulings that barred his lawyers from taking a deposition from Cabey and to throw out last April's award by a Bronx jury.
Lawyers for Cabey declined to comment until they had studied the appeal.

"Bernie feels he never should have been put through it, New York should never have been put through it," Goetz's attorney Darnay Hoffman said. "He is also very concerned about what's going on in the O.J. Simpson civil trial and he feels that something has to be done in this country about the ability of civil juries to overturn a criminal verdict."
In the 1987 criminal trial, Goetz was cleared of assault and attempted murder but served eight months in jail for carrying an illegal weapon.
According to testimony at the trials, Goetz said to Cabey during the shooting, "you don't look so bad. Here's another." Cabey, now in his early 30s, is paralysed and in a wheelchair.
Before the civil trial, judges ruled in favour of Cabey's attorney's claims that he was too brain-damaged to be deposed.
Goetz, 48, and his attorney say a videotape of Cabey taken by a private investigator demonstrated that he was capable of answering lawyers' questions.
The shooting sparked a fierce national debate, with Goetz's supporters seeing him as a frustrated New Yorker who was tired of the high crime rates of the time and fought back.
The teenagers said they were just panhandling and Goetz's critics accused him of being a racist who took justice into his own hands. Goetz is white and the teenagers are black.
